code_examples.section: ltm rule command ANTIFRAUD client id
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::client_id
       Returns client id collected on client side.

SYNOPSIS
       ANTIFRAUD::client_id

DESCRIPTION
       Returns client id collected on client side.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns client id collected on client side.

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when ANTIFRAUD_ALERT {
	    log local0. "client id: [ANTIFRAUD::client_id]."
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-15.0.0
		   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
